description.value: Leighton North Campground sits on Leighton Lake in Tunkwa Park's mid-elevation grasslands, reached by paved road from Savona or Logan Lake; rainbow trout fishing, swimming, and canoeing are the main draws, though resident marmots are known to investigate unattended gear.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tunkwa Park is an active BC Parks site with campgrounds on both Tunkwa and Leighton lakes, matching the OSM record for Leighton North Campground. The park is accessed via paved road (24 km from Savona or 16 km from Logan Lake), about 40 km southwest of Kamloops. OSM confirms fee=yes and internet_access=no. The Tunkwa Park page references frontcountry camping and reservation policies, supporting that reservations are accepted. No cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, shelters) are mentioned on the pages provided, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) belong to the park operator Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd., not BC Parks — could not verify these from the website content provided
OSM confirms internet_access=no; remote location with limited services
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks frontcountry campground accessible by paved road, suitable for touring cyclists passing through the Thompson Plateau region between Savona and Logan Lake.
